title: Portfolio Website
desc: A personal hub where I showcase my AI projects, web applications, technical insights, learning resources, and creative work. Everything is connected in one place to document my journey and share what I build.

title: Publio
desc: Write once, publish everywhere. Publio is a self-hosted social media management platform that enables creators and businesses to publish content across multiple social networks from one unified dashboard.

title: Crash-Archi Workspace
desc: Crash-Archi is an AI-ready project architecture workspace designed to transform raw ideas into structured, reviewable, and development-ready project packages. It focuses on understanding problems, defining architecture, planning solutions, and preparing clear instructions for AI-assisted development.

title: AI Lead Qualification Agent
desc: An AI-powered B2B lead qualification workflow built with Make.com. It automatically researches companies, evaluates inbound leads against Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) criteria using AI, updates Google Sheets with qualification scores, and notifies the sales team via Telegram for high-priority opportunities.

title: AI Knowledge Support Agent
desc: An AI-powered Telegram customer support agent built with Make.com and Google Gemini. It combines Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), conversational memory, and web search fallback to answer customer questions using company documentation while providing fast, accurate, and natural responses.

title: AI Telegram Invoice Extractor Agent
desc: An AI-powered Telegram automation built with Make.com that extracts invoice data from photos and PDFs using AI OCR, stores structured records in Google Sheets, and instantly sends a confirmation summary back to the user.
